title: Account Signal Fusion: Roadmap Prioritization & Commitment Calendar
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create an operationalized intake and prioritization system that fuses signals from top accounts (contracts, escalations, usage anomalies, exec requests) into a single prioritized roadmap queue, and publish a Commitment Calendar that defines when the org will execute on high-touch account asks.
background: We get frequent high-touch requests from top accounts that are currently tracked in multiple channels (CSE tickets, Sales Deal Docs, Support SLAs, Customer Success Miro). This causes duplication, missed expectations, and tension when Sales/CS expect product commitments without a clear cadence or acceptance criteria.
goals: 1) Reduce commitment ambiguity for top accounts by publishing a quarterly Commitment Calendar. 2) Ensure prioritization decisions are traceable to concrete signals (contract clause, revenue risk, strategic partnership, security/compliance needs). 3) Decrease time-to-decision for top-account asks from ~6 weeks to <2 weeks for triage and <8 weeks for delivery planning when accepted.
proposed_solution: Build a lightweight orchestration workflow: (a) standardize intake form for top-account feature requests with required signals; (b) implement an 'Signal Fusion' scoring model that weights contract value, SLO/incident urgency, strategic partnership, and technical feasibility; (c) surface prioritized queue in the PM Console and sync weekly with Sales/CS via commitment calendar; (d) create playbook for binding vs advisory commitments and SLA language templates.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form implemented and linked in CS/Sales playbooks
Signal Fusion scoring outputs a ranked queue and is visible in PM Console for reviewed requests
Commitment Calendar published for Q2 with at least 3 committed items and owner/ETA assigned
Playbook defines acceptance thresholds and SLA language for binding vs advisory commitments
Stakeholder alignment confirmed via sign-off from GTM lead, VP Product, and Legal on commitment wording
success_metrics: Decision latency: median time from intake to triage decision reduced to <14 days
Commitment clarity: CS/Sales survey >= 85% satisfaction on visibility of commitments
Delivery predictability: % of committed items delivered within published ETA >= 80%
Escalation volume: number of duplicate asks across channels reduced by 60%
timeline: Week 1-2: finalize intake form and scoring rubric. Week 3: implement minimal UI in PM Console to list scored requests. Week 4: run pilot with 5 accounts and publish a draft Commitment Calendar. Weeks 5-6: iterate with GTM feedback and finalize playbook. Delivery planning for accepted items aligned to Q2 roadmap slots.
rollout_plan: 1) Pilot: invite 5 top accounts (existing SLAs or strategic pilots) to submit requests via new intake; 2) Internal sync: weekly triage with PM/GTM/Engineering to validate scoring; 3) Publish calendar to Sales/CS and update account-facing CSM dashboards; 4) Expand to full top-50 accounts after 1 quarter if metrics meet targets.
risks_mitigations: Risk: Sales/CS bypass intake when urgent ask arrives. Mitigation: require intake link in handoff template and route urgent exceptions through an on-call executive review that produces a documented decision.
Risk: Scoring model overweights revenue and ignores technical debt. Mitigation: include a feasibility score from Engineering and cap revenue weight in the rubric.
Risk: Legal/contract commitments create liability. Mitigation: Legal review gate and use standardized advisory vs binding language with explicit criteria.
Risk: Increased PM operational burden. Mitigation: automate initial scoring and create a 30-min weekly triage slot rather than ad-hoc meetings.
decision_points: Define weights for Signal Fusion model (revenue vs urgency vs strategic value vs feasibility)
Agree on binding vs advisory language and where Legal sign-off is required
Threshold for a request to be eligible for Commitment Calendar (score cutoff + product/engineering capacity check)
notes: Keep wording conservative for calendar commitments to avoid SLA exposure—Legal prefers 'targeted delivery window' for now.
Engineering estimates will be required at triage for any request scoring > 70 under Signal Fusion.
Consider later integrating runtime metrics (latency/cost impact) from Console to enrich technical feasibility signal.
